messages:
maya_cs: kicking off onboarding for Cedar Health pilot — target: production-ready within 30 days. calling out stakeholders and initial risks. @noah_sales can you confirm commercial success criteria?
noah_sales: yep. primary success = 30d active users + agreement on SLOs. also want a clean path to upsell in Q4. low tolerance for extended downtime.
liam_se: noted. technical owners: Priya (infra), Omar (platform). SSO via SAML, they want VPC peering. we'll need to validate model latency on their dev data.
aj_product: can we pin a model family for pilot? recommend starting with gpt-ish-16k-compatible quantized variant for cost. I'll schedule a model/config review with liam.
sasha_enable: I'll run two enablement sessions: admin onboarding (config, RBAC, billing) and end-user workshop (prompts, safety). propose 60/45min. who owns feedback capture?
maya_cs: Sasha owns feedback capture — we'll ship a weekly feedback deck and a short CSAT pulse after week 2 and post-go-live. also capturing feature asks in the shared doc: https://redwood.app/cedar/pilot-notes
liam_se: quick tech success criteria from infra side: 95th p95 latency < 600ms on 4k tokens baseline; 99.9% availability for scheduled hours; KV cache hit > 30% for conversational flows.
noah_sales: commercial metrics: activation rate > 40% at 30 days, and NPS target >= +30 for pilot cohort. if we miss by > 20% we flag renewal risk.
maya_cs: initial timeline draft: Week 0 (this week) - intake + SSO/VPC scoping; Week 1 - infra + model validation; Week 2 - integration + enablement session 1; Week 3 - end-user workshop + acceptance tests; Week 4 - go-live + smoke tests + CSAT pulse.
aj_product: add a pre-launch dry run with 20 users to validate routing/fallbacks.
sasha_enable: I'll produce the enablement checklist and slide deck by EOD Friday.
maya_cs: action items: (1) liam to confirm SSO/VPC blockers by Thu; (2) aj to run model perf on dev set by Mon; (3) sasha to share enablement slides by Fri; (4) noah to confirm success measurement spreadsheet and coaching plan by Mon.
liam_se: on it. one potential risk — their infra team blocks outbound NAT for model telemetry. if so, we'll need an on-prem log collector.
noah_sales: noted — flagging as medium renewal risk if telemetry not resolved.
onboard-bot: project created: cedar-health-pilot-1765556800 — milestones added: intake, integration, training, go-live.
maya_cs: scheduling a 30min kickoff with all stakeholders tomorrow 11am PT — invite sent. please add any missing owners and react with :thumbsup: if that time works.
sasha_enable: :thumbsup:
liam_se: :thumbsup:
aj_product: :thumbsup:
noah_sales: can do
maya_cs: great — will post the shared checklist and the follow-up notes after the call. anything else?
noah_sales: please ensure renewal KPIs are visible in the weekly status.
maya_cs: will do, weekly status doc linked in the thread. thanks all.
